meta.name: Kaala Paani
meta.description:
Set in the near future, the Andaman and Nicobar Islands are quarantined from the rest of the world as a mystery disease engulfs them, prompting the islanders to attempt an unprecedented feat in human history - escaping the Kaala Paani.

Complete series. On your server: S1 7/7

videos.title: Nature Wins
videos.overview: Dr. Soudamini Singh investigates the source of a mysterious illness in the region as a massive festival brings thousands of tourists to Port Blair.

videos.title: The Switch
videos.overview: As a crisis unfolds, Lt. Gen. Qadri takes crucial steps — but fails to alert the public. Jyotsna struggles to escape her traumatic past.

videos.title: Garjen
videos.overview: With the islands under lockdown, Santosh works relentlessly to reunite with his children, while an ailing Gargi ponders her role as their guardian.

videos.title: Eraba Reta Mono
videos.overview: Jyotsna and the kids search for an isolated bunker and a reclusive older man with crucial supplies. Ketan recounts the reason behind his transfer.

videos.title: The Immortal Being
videos.overview: Rage consumes a grieving Chiranjeevi — only for him to uncover a shocking link to an Indigenous tribe. Ritu and Ketan team up to find a rare plant.

videos.title: Forefathers
videos.overview: After making a startling discovery, Ritu faces immense pressure to navigate a potential cure — but can she outrun her past?

videos.title: Darwin's Bay
videos.overview: While thousands prepare to evacuate the island, Qadri faces an unprecedented dilemma and a harrowing question: Is one life worth more than another?
